name: Mimileu
source:
The mountain deity that governs these parts.
Complains about how things are annoying a lot, but she's actually the hardest worker around.
An elite who quit being a reaper to take up being a mountain deity. 

According to herself, she can apparently turn metal axes into gold ones, but it is still unknown if there is any truth to that. 
She has perfect control of the flow of water and can cause huge waves at will, but is apparently limited in her movements in places devoid of water. 
A number of her water-based techniques utilize her own power, not her power as a mountain deity.

[In-game profile]
